history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this CSV row describes the same temple as seq 2054 (Nasiyan Jain Temple / Soniji Ki Nasiyan, Ajmer); kept as a separate file per the one-file-per-row rule. NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — Jain temple (Digambar), keep-or-drop decision needed. Ajmer's famous Red Temple on Prithvi Raj Marg, built by Rai Bahadur Seth Moolchand Soni and his son Nemichand Soni under the guidance of Pandit Sadasukhdasji of Jaipur, dedicated to Lord Rishabhdev (Adinath), the first Tirthankara. Its fame rests on the Swarna Nagari ('City of Gold'), a chamber of gold-plated wooden figures - reportedly some 1,000 kg of gold - depicting the life of Rishabhdev (the Panch Kalyanak per the Adi Purana of Acharya Jinasena), Ayodhya, celestial vehicles, animals and rivers; the halls also have delicate paintings from Jain scriptures. The two-storied complex has a South-Indian-style gopuram entrance in red stone from Karauli, one part being the worship area and the other a museum. NOTE: opening hours conflict across sources (8:30 AM-4:30 PM most common; some say 8:00 AM-6:00 PM) - verify.

name: Ajmer Jain Temple (Soniji Ki Nasiyan)
town_description: Ajmer is one of Rajasthan's oldest cities, ringed by the Aravalli hills around the Ana Sagar Lake. It is a major pilgrimage centre - home to the Ajmer Sharif Dargah, the Soniji Ki Nasiyan Jain temple and the historic Akbar Fort museum - and a key rail and road hub of central Rajasthan, about 135 km from Jaipur and 14 km from Pushkar.

travel.airport: Kishangarh Airport (Ajmer), about 27-31 km away; Jaipur International Airport about 135 km away.
travel.railway: Ajmer Junction Railway Station, about 1 km from the temple on Prithvi Raj Marg (per tourmyindia).
travel.road: On Prithvi Raj Marg in central Ajmer, near Akbar Fort; local taxis and auto-rickshaws reach it from anywhere in the city.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, when Rajasthan's weather is pleasant.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported as 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM daily by most sources; some list 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM - verify. Nominal entry fee around Rs 10 (Indians) / Rs 25 (foreigners) - verify.
